scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view from a car window, showing a white car driving down a two-way street lined with tall buildings and trees. The street has a crosswalk and a stop sign. There are parked cars along the side of the street, as well as some parked motorcycles. The sky is partly cloudy.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are tall and modern, with large windows and balconies.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has a smooth texture.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees lining the street, providing shade and greenery.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a stop sign and a pedestrian crossing signal.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground surfaces are mostly flat and smooth.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The street is relatively open, with a few trees and bushes separating the buildings.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are a few people walking on the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is bright and sunny, with a few clouds in the sky.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet and peaceful, with a few people going about their daily business.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and restaurants, and there are several people taking photos.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is bustling with students and young professionals.
